description: High-level fluent hook builder, dex analysis caching, reflection helpers, and Kotlin DSL extensions

components.name: io.github.libxposed.helper.HookBuilder
components.summary: Fluent and declarative builder for discovering classes, methods, constructors, and fields to hook with lazy sequences and dex analysis.

methods.name: buildHooks
methods.signature: static Future<?> buildHooks(@NonNull XposedInterface ctx, @NonNull BaseDexClassLoader classLoader, @NonNull String sourcePath, Consumer<HookBuilder> consumer)
methods.doc: Main entry point to define declarative hooks on a classloader with optional dex analysis caching.

methods.name: setForceDexAnalysis
methods.doc: Enables/disables full dex analysis if bytecode introspection is required.

methods.name: methods
methods.doc: Finds all methods matching the specified criteria.

methods.name: firstMethod
methods.doc: Finds the first method matching the specified criteria.

methods.name: constructors
methods.doc: Finds all constructors matching the specified criteria.

methods.name: firstConstructor
methods.doc: Finds the first constructor matching the specified criteria.

methods.name: fields
methods.doc: Finds all fields matching the specified criteria.

methods.name: firstField
methods.doc: Finds the first field matching the specified criteria.

methods.name: classes
methods.doc: Finds all classes matching the specified criteria.

methods.name: firstClass
methods.doc: Finds the first class matching the specified criteria.

methods.name: exactClass
methods.doc: Finds a class by its exact canonical name.

methods.name: exactMethod
methods.doc: Finds a method by its exact signature or name.

methods.name: exactConstructor
methods.doc: Finds a constructor by its exact signature.

components.name: io.github.libxposed.helper.Reflector
components.summary: Internal reflection acceleration and caching engine with WeakReference caches. Parses smali-style signatures (e.g., 'com.target.Class->method(Ljava/lang/String;)V') and canonical names.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.signature: Class<?> loadClass(@NonNull String className) throws ClassNotFoundException
methods.doc: Resolves class with abbreviation decoding, inner-class fallback ($), and WeakReference caching.

methods.name: loadMethod
methods.signature: Method loadMethod(@NonNull String methodString) throws ClassNotFoundException, NoSuchMethodException
methods.doc: Resolves method from signature like 'Class->method(ParamType):ReturnType' with caching.

methods.name: loadConstructor
methods.signature: Constructor<?> loadConstructor(@NonNull String constructorString) throws ClassNotFoundException, NoSuchMethodException
methods.doc: Resolves constructor from signature like 'Class-><init>(ParamType)' with caching.

methods.name: loadField
methods.signature: Field loadField(@NonNull String fieldString) throws ClassNotFoundException, NoSuchFieldException
methods.doc: Resolves field from signature like 'Class->field:Type' with caching.

components.summary: Idiomatic Kotlin DSL extensions for LibXposed hook declarations.
